Well, I tend to avoid regrets. Who we are is shaped by our experiences. Regrets are another way of saying you don't like who you are now. Everything that happened to me, good or bad, led me to this point. I wouldn't want to change a damn thing.

That said, approaching fifty years, I still have some regrets. Simple truth is that you regret more the things you failed to do far more than the things you did do. I regret not spending more time with those who died. I wish I could have one more conversation with my Grandfather. One more night drinking with my friends who died. One more hour with my daughter.

Everything else? Hell, I made more than my share of mistakes. I did everything the hard way. No regrets there.
